The '''rules''' of ''Star Wars'' CCG exist in two layers that this wiki keeps separate:

* '''Decipher rules''' — what Decipher published for the printed game (1995–2001). No Players Committee modifications.
* '''Players Committee rules''' — the current tournament document, the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]].

[[Rulebooks]] is the library of original PDFs (archived Decipher files and working copies). Wiki transcriptions of those documents live as their own articles so sections can be linked.

== Wiki rule documents ==

* [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]] — how to play (Special Edition booklet, November 1998)
* [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]] — comprehensive rules and rulings as of November 1998
* [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]] — official rulings after Glossary 2.0 (updated 29 January 2002; gameplay changes effective 4 February 2002)
* [[Decipher Comprehensive Rules]] — one amalgamated Decipher-only document (Rulebook 2.0 + Glossary 2.0 + Glossary Supplement + later Decipher rulesheets). No PC changes.
* [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] — wiki form of the PC Advanced Rulebook PDF

== How they relate ==

Decipher's last official rules index listed the Glossary and Glossary Supplement as the documents that answer gameplay questions, plus the Version 2.0 rulebook and later expansion rulesheets (Endor through Theed Palace).<ref name="decipher-rules">https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/index.html</ref>

The Players Committee Advanced Rulebook is a later document. It replaces previous rulebooks and glossaries '''for PC play''' and includes PC rulings and errata. It is not a Decipher publication.
